options.reason: A line chart makes year-to-year changes in the annual fatality count easy to follow.
Bars emphasize the absolute number in each distinct calendar year and support direct comparisons between years.

options.metric: Annual number of pedestrians killed, partitioned by recorded borough
options.denominator: None (raw counts; borough stacks sum to the annual citywide count)
options.grouping: Crash year and borough, with missing borough recorded as Unknown / missing
options.reason: The borough stacks retain the annual citywide totals while showing how the recorded geography contributes to each total.
options.answer: Summing the borough segments gives these NYC annual totals (including crashes with unknown or missing borough): 2013: 176; 2014: 133; 2015: 133; 2016: 149; 2017: 127; 2018: 123; 2019: 131; 2020: 101; 2021: 132; 2022: 135; 2023: 107; 2024: 124; 2025: 119.

answer:
